orgora-charts-cloud.note: Grok Bot / remote: user Connects Google or Microsoft (same SSO as Orgora). Charts stay in their Drive or OneDrive. Requires Authorization Bearer + X-Orgora-Provider from the Connect flow.

orgora-charts.note: Mac desktop / Grok Build only. Local stdio helper from Orgora Charts → MCP connector → Enable. No network. If missing, tell the user to Enable — this plugin does not download a binary.
